text:
matt.p: Kicking off thread for the pilot cohort recruitment + launch-qualifiers handoff. Need a crisp checklist we can share with solutions for outreach.

rachel.s: +1. goal = 8 high-fit pilot customers, staggered over 3 waves. prefer teams with latency-sensitive workloads (realtime chat, search rerank).

devin_se: We should surface exact technical guardrails up front. e.g. required telemetry, VPN or SSO, sample traffic shape, and any data residency constraints. otherwise we waste cycles.

sara-cs: Proposed incentives: 3 months free dedicated capacity + prioritized onboarding + co-marketing credit. also offer a $3k engineering credit for integration work. thoughts?

wilson-research: For feedback loop, I want weekly 30m syncs for wave 1, biweekly for wave 2/3. also a short daily stand for first 72h after onboarding for any perf regressions.

matt.p: Nice. We also need explicit success metrics per partner and for the program overall. I'm thinking: 1) integration time (target < 10 days full integration), 2) latency p95 improvement/antiregression (must stay within 1.2x of baseline), 3) eval quality drift < 5% on partner prompt set, 4) adoption (requests/day) milestone.

rachel.s: Can we define "integration time" more narrowly? e.g., from kickoff to validated inference calls hitting our sandbox with KV cache working + tracing.

devin_se: Agreed. Add acceptance criteria: at least one end-to-end flow exercised, trace ID present, and test harness replay of 1000 requests. We can provide a small harness script to partners.

sara-cs: I'll draft a one-pager for CSMs with those items and the incentives. Will also include legal checklist for data access (PII, logs retention).

matt.p: On prioritization: we should score candidates by (a) product fit (0-5), (b) likely usage volume (0-5), (c) compliance complexity (0-5 inverted), (d) strategic value (0-5). pick top 8 with min avg score 3.5.

wilson-research: Suggest adding an "evaluation signal" bucket: partners willing to share prompt sets and allow periodic A/B tests get +1. that helps our quality monitoring.

rachel.s: Recruitment funnel: outreach -> screening call (SE + PM) -> technical intake doc -> 2-week pilot slot offer. Need templates for screening questions.

devin_se: I'll paste a short screening template we can reuse: 
```
1) primary latency/throughput requirements (p50/p95/p99)
2) average request size and max tokens
3) concurrency expectations
4) data residency / compliance needs
5) willingness to run evals & share prompt examples
```

sara-cs: Perfect. Also add a checkbox for "on-prem or VPC required". that changes the onboarding path.

matt.p: Launch criteria for exiting pilot -> public beta: 
- 8 partners onboarded and passing acceptance criteria across 2 waves
- Quality regressions < 5% on aggregate evals
- Latency SLOs met for 90% of partners (p95 under target)
- No critical security findings and legal signoffs for data handling
- Runbook + onboarding docs validated by at least 2 partners

wilson-research: And metrics for success: reduction in mean tokens/inference cost (measured pre/post), partner NPS >= 7, and at least 3 partners convert to paid Dedicated within 90 days of beta.

rachel.s: For scope negotiation: if a partner requests heavy model changes or deep offline training, that becomes out-of-scope for the pilot and moves to a paid engagement. we should be explicit.

devin_se: Agreed. We'll add a clause: no model architecture changes during pilot; quantization/engine tweaks allowed if they don't affect functional output. any major model changes require separate SOW.

sara-cs: Ops note: onboarding team needs a "fast track" checklist for partners who meet all infra pre-reqs. should save us ~3 days per partner.

oncall-bot: deploybot: onboarding-playbook v0.3 deployed to /internal/docs/onboarding-playbook (audit id: pb-20274).

matt.p: Great—sara, can you share the one-pager and the incentives table by EOD tomorrow? Devin, can you publish the screening template + harness script to the shared drive? Wilson, draft the eval plan for each wave. I'll consolidate and share the partner-facing packet by Friday.

rachel.s: I'll create a Notion template for the screening call and scoring rubric after I get Devin's template.

sara-cs: On it.

devin_se: ETA tomorrow noon PT for the script.

wilson-research: Draft eval plan by Thursday.

matt.p: Cool—follow-ups: add an "exit feedback" survey to collect structured lessons at pilot end (NPS, pain points, suggested features). keep it < 8 questions.

rachel.s: I'll draft survey after Wilson's eval signals so we align metrics.

matt.p: If no objections, i'll convert this into a short checklist and post in #pm-announce later today.

sara-cs: no objections. :thumbsup:

devin_se: lgtm

wilson-research: lgtm

oncall-bot: reminder: next onboarding sync Thu 10:00am PT.

matt.p: thanks everyone.
